Home.woodIntro: General properties of the four woods most used outdoors. The right choice depends on sun and water exposure, budget and how much upkeep you want.

iroko.name: Iroko
iroko.durability: High; its natural extractives resist rot and insects
iroko.care: Regular oiling to keep the colour

teak.name: Teak
teak.durability: Very high; oily, dense grain, water resistant
teak.care: Regular oiling; weathers to silver grey if left untreated

pine.name: Treated pine
pine.durability: Moderate; relies on treatment and upkeep

thermo.name: Thermowood
thermo.durability: High; moves less with moisture, no chemical preservatives
thermo.care: Oil against UV; dents more easily than solid hardwood
